svg.title: File Transfer
svg.desc: You to Kit and repository: Start new work. You to Kit and repository: Send your task so the Kit publishes it to the repository. Command: agentic-kit transfer submit-user-task. You to AI assistant: Write g in the chat. AI assistant to Kit and repository: Read the published task before working. Command: agentic-kit transfer read-user-task. You to Kit and repository: Run Check, then use Finish & publish after review.
